verdict.rationale: Square documents webhooks and a Webhook Subscriptions API that deliver real-time event notifications. These are developer building blocks for constructing event-driven automation, not a product-native way to define rules that automatically trigger actions. No evidence shows a rule or automation builder in Square itself, so the support is adjacent only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Square webhooks, which let developers receive real-time notifications of events, such as inventory changes and Point of Sale payments.
